guion: A stolen lifeguard truck, and the cops are right there on the sand. The cruiser hits him from the side and spins him into the palms. That's basically a PIT maneuver, the move real U.S. police use to end a chase. It doesn't end this one. He reverses out, finds the beach again, the cop comes back for round two, and he dives straight into the jungle. Ditch the truck, or keep going?
